name: Damascus (Syria, until 2024)
description: A white field bearing the logo of the Damascus Governorate — a jasmine flower on green and light-blue shapes — above the governorate's name in Arabic and English.
history: The jasmine logo of the Damascus Governorate, used on a white flag until the fall of the Assad government in December 2024; the governorate launched a competition for a new visual identity in 2025.

features.role: jasmine flower on green and light-blue background
